subject: Private deployment MAP & GPU sizing — HelmTech capacity handshake
messages:
From: Peter Lawson <peter.lawson@helmtech.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
Cc: Anya Patel <anya.patel@helmtech.com>
Date: 2026-10-25 09:12 -0700
Subject: Private deployment MAP & GPU sizing — HelmTech capacity handshake

Hi Elliot / Maya,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with Redwood’s latency profile and the private deployment option. We’re trying to lock down a mutual action plan (MAP) so we can commit to a Dedicated/Private reservation for Q1. High level context:

- Use case: customer-facing assistant integrated into our product UI (search + summarization + actions).
- Target region: US (primary), EU read replicas later.
- Expected go-live: staged rollout starting 2027-02 with full production by 2027-05.

What we need from Redwood to finalize procurement and internal approvals:
1) Recommended GPU pool sizing (conservative / nominal / aggressive) for the above timeline and expected throughput (see below).
2) Lead times for on-prem/VPC appliance procurement vs. Dedicated reserved capacity (weeks to ship & provision).
3) A one-page MAP draft showing milestones, acceptance criteria, and invoicing cadence we can attach to procurement.

Initial workload signals:
- Peak concurrency target: ~120 concurrent requests (chat-style sessions) at steady-state peak.
- Average tokens per call: ~800 tokens total (prompt + conversation).
- Model target: Llama-2-chat 70B quantized (we plan to evaluate 70B and 40B variants).
- Latency SLO: 600ms p95 token generation; interactive response under 1.5s for end-to-end.

Attached a short SOC2 checklist and a rough architecture diagram. Can you reply with a quick sizing sketch and a draft MAP that we can iterate on with procurement?

Best,
Peter Lawson
Head of Platform Integrations
HelmTech

Attachment: HelmTech_capacity_diagram.png (image)
Attachment: SOC2-request.pdf (pdf)

From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
To: Peter Lawson <peter.lawson@helmtech.com>
Cc: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-26 10:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment MAP & GPU sizing — HelmTech capacity handshake

Hi Peter — thanks for the detail and for sending the SOC2 checklist. Short answer: we can put a MAP together this week with three sizing scenarios and clear lead-time windows for both Dedicated and Private (on-prem/VPC).

Quick notes up front:
- Model choices materially change GPU counts; quantized 70B will need more memory budget but benefits from token throughput optimizations we run in the runtime.
- Your 120 concurrent sessions at ~800 tokens implies a steady-state token/sec profile that we should convert to peak tokens/sec to size the pool. I’ll sketch that below.

Sizing sketch (back-of-envelope):
- Workload conversion: assume 2 messages/sec per session during peak (conservative for chat bursts) => 240 messages/sec. At 800 tokens/msg => 192k tokens/sec peak.
- Baseline throughput per A100-80GB equiv (quantized path, continuous batching): ~25k tokens/sec (conservative).
- Conservative pool: 8 GPUs (~200k tokens/sec) — single region, supports short bursts and leaves margin for evictions.
- Nominal pool (recommended): 10 GPUs (~250k tokens/sec) — supports 120 sessions comfortably plus expected growth to 150 concurrent.
- Aggressive pool: 14 GPUs (~350k tokens/sec) — headroom for heavier prompts, larger context windows, and EU read replicas/DR planning.

Lead times (typical):
- Dedicated (Redwood-managed reserved capacity): 2–4 weeks to provision v1 tranche (depends on available capacity in region).
- Dedicated + burst tranches: 3–6 weeks to scale beyond initial tranche depending on vendor procurement windows.
- Private (on-prem appliance / VPC with customer network): 6–12 weeks — includes hardware procurement (if on-prem), network peering, and KMS/HSM integration.

Deliverables I’ll attach to the MAP draft:
- Milestone table (eval -> pilot -> acceptance -> full commit) with acceptance criteria tied to latency and token cost ceilings.
- Required inputs from HelmTech by milestone (sample prompts, traffic shape, security contact).
- Payment and invoicing cadence options (monthly tranche vs. quarterly commit).

Next steps / asks from you:
- Confirm whether you want Redwood to size for 70B quantized only or include a 40B fallback for cost/speed tradeoffs.
- Confirm any blackout dates / procurement windows in Nov–Dec for your finance team.

I’ll drop a draft MAP (HelmTech_MAP_v1.xlsx) in Drive and propose a quick 30-min alignment next Tuesday (10/31) 10:00am PT.

Thanks — Elliot
Elliot Price
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
Attachment: HelmTech_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Peter Lawson <peter.lawson@helmtech.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
Cc: Anya Patel <anya.patel@helmtech.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01 08:27 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment MAP & GPU sizing — HelmTech capacity handshake

Elliot — thanks for the quick sketch, that helps a lot. A couple of clarifications from procurement & engineering:

- We want both 70B and 40B sizing lines in the MAP. Procurement will prefer a smaller committed baseline if a staged fallback to 40B is available.
- Finance has a year-end blackout window from 2026-12-20 to 2027-01-05; we need PO approval before 2026-12-15 ideally.
- For lead times: if Dedicated can guarantee a 2-week provisioning SLAT (within region), that materially helps our decision. Can Redwood commit to a tranche-level SLA in writing?
- Security asks: please attach the SOC2 evidence and the network diagram callout. We’ll push the SOC2 checklist to our GRC team for an initial pass.

We can do the 10/31 sync but would prefer the meeting pushed to 11/02 at 11:00am PT — that gives our procurement team time to prepare the PO draft. Is that OK?

Regards,
Peter

Date: 2026-11-08 16:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment MAP & GPU sizing — HelmTech capacity handshake

Peter / Anya — thanks, call on 11/02 worked well. Attached is an updated MAP (HelmTech_MAP_v1.xlsx) with the two-model sizing lines and a tranche-based procurement option. Summary of what we recommend and the close timeline we propose:

Executive summary (single paragraph):
Redwood recommends a nominal 10-GPU Dedicated tranche (A100-80GB equiv) for initial commit with an optional EU read replica and a staged fallback to a 40B variant to reduce committed baseline cost. Dedicated can generally provision an initial tranche in 2 weeks for US regions; Private (customer-hosted) timelines remain 6–12 weeks. To meet your procurement window and PO deadline (12/15), we suggest a signed commitment by 2026-11-22 to allow a 2–4 week provisioning buffer and legal/doc cycles.

Concrete proposal (milestones & dates):
- 2026-11-09: Send final MAP + SOW to HelmTech (attached link).
- 2026-11-15: Procurement PO draft due from HelmTech.
- 2026-11-22: Signed commitment (DocuSign link below) for initial tranche (10 GPUs).
- 2026-12-06: Go-live pilot (smoke & performance tests).
- 2027-02-01: Staged production rollout start.

Sizing table (condensed):
- 40B fallback: baseline 6 GPUs; nominal 8 GPUs; aggressive 12 GPUs.
- 70B quantized: baseline 8 GPUs; nominal 10 GPUs; aggressive 14 GPUs.

Acceptance criteria for pilot:
- Average p95 token generation latency <= 600ms across representative prompts.
- No more than 2% error/failure rate over 24-hour smoke window.
- Cost per 1k tokens within agreed estimate (+/- 10%).

SLA / provisioning:
- Redwood will include a tranche provisioning SLA of 2 weeks for initial US Dedicated tranches; SLA exceptions will be documented in the SOW for any vendor capacity shortages.

Action items (owners):
- HelmTech (Peter): Finalize PO draft by 11/15; confirm preferred invoicing cadence (monthly vs quarterly).
- HelmTech (Anya): Share sample traffic capture and top-50 prompts by 11/10 for acceptance testing.
- Redwood (Elliot): Publish final MAP + SOW and send DocuSign request by 11/09.
- Redwood (Maya): Coordinate SOC2 artifact handoff to HelmTech GRC.

Links & attachments:
- MAP (Drive): https://drive.redwood/HelmTech/Maps/HelmTech_MAP_v1.xlsx
- DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/templates/7a3f2d
- HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/HT-2394

If this looks good I’ll send the DocuSign request today and we can aim for the 11/22 signature to hit your procurement window.

Thanks — Elliot
Elliot Price
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
